Q12. The following questions are Assertion-Reason based questions. Choose the answer based on the codes given below.
(1) A is True and R is False (2) A is False and R is True (3) Both A and R are True (4) Both A and R are False
Assertion (A): Effectors are the part of our body which, on receiving stimulus, set up waves of impulses towards the central nervous system.
Reason (R): The specialized epithelial cells of certain organs are capable of receiving stimuli which can be light, sound, heat, pain, hunger, etc.
(a) (1) (b) (2) (c) (3) (d) (4)

[1 mark(s)] Source: Book — Selina Concise Biology X, Review Questions A.12

Q13. The following questions are Assertion-Reason based questions. Choose the answer based on the codes given below.
(1) A is True and R is False (2) A is False and R is True (3) Both A and R are True (4) Both A and R are False
Assertion (A): The aggregates of the cell bodies or perikaryons of neurons form the synapse.
Reason (R): Ganglia are the structures from which the nerve fibres may arise or enter into, whereas the synapse connects two neurons with a small gap in between.
(a) (1) (b) (2) (c) (3) (d) (4)

[1 mark(s)] Source: Book — Selina Concise Biology X, Review Questions A.13

Q14. The following questions are Assertion-Reason based questions. Choose the answer based on the codes given below.
(1) A is True and R is False (2) A is False and R is True (3) Both A and R are True (4) Both A and R are False
Assertion (A): The cerebellum is the largest portion of the brain.
Reason (R): Cerebellum is located just at the base of the cerebrum. It maintains body balance. Cerebrum is the seat of intelligence, consciousness and will power.
(a) (1) (b) (2) (c) (3) (d) (4)

[1 mark(s)] Source: Book — Selina Concise Biology X, Review Questions A.14

Q15. The following questions are Assertion-Reason based questions. Choose the answer based on the codes given below.
(1) A is True and R is False (2) A is False and R is True (3) Both A and R are True (4) Both A and R are False
Assertion (A): The protective membranous covering of the brain and spinal cord are the same, whereas the bony coverings of these are cranium and vertebral column respectively.
Reason (R): Since both are very delicate and sensitive organs of our body, they are protected by a three-layered membrane known as meninges.
(a) (1) (b) (2) (c) (3) (d) (4)

[1 mark(s)] Source: Book — Selina Concise Biology X, Review Questions A.15

Q16. The following questions are Assertion-Reason based questions. Choose the answer based on the codes given below.
(1) A is True and R is False (2) A is False and R is True (3) Both A and R are True (4) Both A and R are False
Assertion (A): The arrangement of white and gray matter is the same in both brain and spinal cord.
Reason (R): Gray matter consists of cell bodies of the neuron, whereas white matter contains the axons of the nerve cells. One region is termed as the cortex and the other is medulla.
(a) (1) (b) (2) (c) (3) (d) (4)

[1 mark(s)] Source: Book — Selina Concise Biology X, Review Questions A.16

Q17. The following questions are Assertion-Reason based questions. Choose the answer based on the codes given below.

Reason (R): Sympathetic nervous system prepares the body for violent action against abnormal conditions. Adrenaline is termed as emergency hormone.
(a) (1) (b) (2) (c) (3) (d) (4)
